name: Ottakringer Brauerei
notes: The listing URL from meta (/de/events/) redirects to a rental-location page with no data; the real listing lives at /de/events-locations/eventkalender/ (linked from nav). Server-rendered HTML, no ld+json, no XHR endpoint, no pagination (all ~38 upcoming occurrences on one page). Listing gives day/month + time but no year and isn't strictly chronological (a Nov date appears after a Dec one, and a March-next-year date is tacked on last), so scrape.py fetches each event's detail page to read the authoritative 'DD.MM.YYYY[ - DD.MM.YYYY]' date line and description. price_min/category always null (site never states prices or categories; tickets go through external sellers like oeticket). venue/district hardcoded to the brewery (Ottakringer Brauerei, 1160) since every event is on-site.
